tagline: “The better way to operate.” Precision micro blades and ergonomic handles for the most delicate procedures.
overview: The Microknife is a compact instrument developed for the most demanding professionals — a remarkable combination of portability, versatility and performance. The ergonomically designed FairGrip handle delivers maximum control for precise, effective cutting with microtools.

feats.d: The ergonomic FairGrip handle ensures maximum control, making cutting with microtools more precise and effective.
The soft, durable grip offers exceptional comfort in long sessions, reducing fatigue and increasing productivity.
The firm, secure grip minimises the risk of accidents and injuries, for a safer working experience.

modelos.d: Angled tip for controlled access in narrow fields.
Double-bevelled crescent edge for precise dissection.
Ergonomic titanium/steel handle, compatible with every blade.

uso.d: Select the blade geometry (15° angled or crescent) suited to the procedure and mount it on the FairGrip handle.
Hold the ergonomic handle for maximum control and stability during the incision.
Make clean, exact cuts while protecting the adjacent vital structures — ideal for minimally invasive work.

tagline: Cannulas and needles for radiofrequency — a minimally invasive, target-selective technique in the treatment of chronic pain.
overview: Radiofrequency is a minimally invasive, target-selective technique for treating chronic pain. Radimed cannulas and needles give the interventionalist the precise access the procedure depends on — from the diagnostic block to denervation.

feats.d: A minimally invasive, target-selective technique for treating chronic pain.

feats.t: Facet joint injection in chronic low back pain
feats.d: Clinical assessment of facet joint injection in the treatment of facet syndrome.

tagline: Bone marrow aspiration system for advanced stem cell harvesting — regenerative, minimally invasive treatments.
overview: Marrow Cellution is a bone marrow aspiration system designed to maximise harvest quality at the point of care — recovering marrow cells at multiple depths while minimising dilution by peripheral blood.

feats.t: Higher stem cell concentration per aspirate
feats.d: A multi-level harvesting technique that minimises dilution by peripheral blood.
A compilation of references is available for technical evaluation and tender documentation.

tagline: Coral-derived bioactive bone graft. CNN Business covered its manufacturing, applicability and benefits.
overviewT: From the coral farm to bone regeneration
overview: CoreBone is a bioactive bone graft grown from coral in a controlled environment, free from the risk of disease transmission. It combines mechanical strength and bioactivity for bone regeneration in dentistry and orthopaedics.

feats.d: A mineral structure close to human bone, with mechanical strength and bioactivity.
The report showed the coral farm, the manufacturing process and the benefits of the graft.

tagline: Water pouch for continuous lip moistening — comfort during post-surgical recovery.
overviewT: Continuous comfort, less load on staff
overview: Lipsus continuously moistens the lips of a recovering patient — a simple form of care that improves post-surgical well-being and frees the clinical team and the family for other activities.

feats.d: Constant relief for the discomfort of dry lips after surgery.
Fewer interruptions to moisten manually — more time for what matters.
Optimises patient comfort throughout post-surgical recovery.

tagline: The OSSIX guided regeneration line, from Dentsply Sirona's Regenerative Solutions division — a global reference in dentistry.
overview: OSSIX is Dentsply Sirona's family of regenerative biomaterials, built on GLYMATRIX technology: porcine type I collagen cross-linked with sugar, a process close to the body's natural glycation. The line has been used by clinicians for over 20 years in hundreds of thousands of bone and tissue regeneration procedures.

feats.d: Cross-linked collagen barrier membrane for GBR and GTR, with a real barrier effect of 4 to 6 months — maintained even in case of exposure — that ossifies over the course of the process.
Volumising scaffold: placed under the flap, it increases soft tissue thickness across different indications that call for additional volume.
An ossifying collagen sponge that increases the amount of vital bone without leaving residual particles after four months.
